next_gate.goal: Inventory genuine Red offer families, add the smallest reusable target-specific evolution and party-development providers, and freeze one complete fifteen-recipe forty-five-offer plan before any root claim.
next_gate.training_readiness_after_gate: A complete authentic plan opens a separately authorized setup-capture campaign. Only completed same-root captures then open randomized selected-arm outcomes and the next train-only model fit.

repair_result.account_wide_no_retry: A current-user owner-private registry claims the byte-derived physical root under an exclusive lease; relabeling a catalog identity or using another local store cannot reopen it.
repair_result.authenticated_route: Each concrete semantic route is identity-bound, executed by its sealed planner and emulator, independently verified, retained as an authenticated report, and required to produce a measurable emulator-state change.
repair_result.closed_failure_surface: Only a finite public failure vocabulary is accepted; arbitrary private values and digest-shaped reasons cannot enter receipts.
repair_result.complete_proof_joins: Construction, origin, every candidate fork, terminal observation, provider offer, semantic family, route report, and final restore are cryptographically and structurally joined.
repair_result.execution_identity: The Red title, revision, ROM identities, clean published source, state schema, adapter, observation, route, provider, and runtime digests are sealed through plan, claim, capture, and terminal.
repair_result.independent_effect_meter: One exact concrete executor-owned meter counts controller actions, emulator frames, behavior draws, learner labels and outcomes, model predictions and fits, provider executions, teacher queries, and root claims.
repair_result.restore_readback: Every arm receives a fresh isolated runtime, loads the exact saved bytes, saves them back, and must reproduce both the exact bytes and complete origin observation before route execution.
repair_result.sealed_provider_construction: A real registry constructs the profile-bound provider offer from a fresh destination observation; setup validation never invokes its executor or verifier.
repair_result.typed_semantic_families: Family descriptors derive from the underlying acquisition, evolution, development, storage, resupply, story, or exploration mechanics and reject slot, root, route, profile, and candidate-order identity.
repair_result.restart_safety: Success, ordinary failure, and pre-local recovery transitions are covered by failpoints; a second interruption during recovery remains terminal and cannot grant a retry.
